contract: model.available() reads fresh credential/integration/provider availability, then determines each model's eligibility identity before performing model metadata projection.
Base models use their own effective model.providerID, not their parent provider ID. Virtual models use the current virtual credential provider ID.
Eligibility identity reads and errors precede API/request/top-level projection. Hidden models do not execute those projection getters, spreads, nested schema validation or release sorting.
Provider discovery still reads its own authentication metadata; its API/request roots are not blanket-suppressed.
Selected models invoke the full original projectModel, including its original ModelV2.Info.make lookup order. A final filter checks the actual projected providerID and enabled state.
all()/get() retain original full projection and validation, including errors for hidden metadata.
